1.mascotDialogue: A collision here is not an error at all, beta — it is an expected outcome, the whole design plans for it! Each bucket just becomes its own tiny linked list instead of one single slot.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 13 is the whole strategy, beta — instead of overwriting whatever is already sitting in the bucket, the new node just points at it and becomes the new head. Nothing is ever lost to a collision, nothing!

3.mascotDialogue: Bucket 3 is now hanging a two-node chain off its side, beta — 17, inserted after 10, lands right at the head, exactly like insert-at-head predicts.

4.mascotDialogue: The chain looks perfectly fine, beta — one node, no dangling pointer in sight. That is the trap! The bug is not a broken pointer, it is a silently vanished one, and this app shows you 'lost node' explicitly so it never stays invisible.
